'''2011 Belgium Regionals Angelo Consoli DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Angelo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
